title: Ask about the hall
disclaimer: AI assistant. For anything official, please contact us.
greeting: Hi! Ask me anything about Fellowship Event Hall — capacity, pricing, what's included, open dates. I can also book your tour right here in the chat.
suggestions: Can I come see the hall?
Can I bring my own catering?
error: Sorry, I couldn't answer just now. Please try again, or reach us through the contact form.
rateLimited: You've sent a lot of messages. Please try again in a few minutes.

booked.heading: Tour booked
booked.body: {{when}} (Eastern Time). A confirmation with a calendar invite is on its way to {{email}}.

consent.heading: Before we start
consent.body: This is a live voice call with our AI assistant. Your voice is sent to our speech provider, BytePlus, where it is turned into text and processed on servers outside the United States so the assistant can answer. We do not record the call or keep the audio ourselves.
consent.booking: If you book a tour, the details you give are saved the same way as on our booking form.
consent.limit: Calls are kept to a few minutes.

typed.label: Type your email or phone number
typed.placeholder: Type it here instead of saying it

ended.heading: Call ended
ended.timeUp: That was the longest a call can run. You can start another, or carry on in the text chat.

errors.micDenied: We could not use your microphone. Allow microphone access in your browser settings and try again, or use the text chat.
errors.noMic: No microphone was found on this device. The text chat works without one.
errors.unsupported: Voice calls do not work in this browser. The text chat does.
errors.busy: Our voice line is busy right now. Please use the text chat, or call us.
errors.rateLimited: You have reached the limit for voice calls today. The text chat is still here.
errors.failed: The call could not connect. Please try again, or use the text chat.
errors.dropped: The call was cut off. You can call again, or carry on in the text chat.

spoken.welcome: Hi, I'm the AI assistant for Fellowship Event Hall. What can I help you with?
spoken.fallback: Sorry, I could not answer that just now. You can call or message us with the buttons on your screen.
